evidence: One runtime-fact drift: frozen task/environment/instructions/integration.md:7 says 'HOME points to the directory containing the running app copy.' Frozen task/tests/test.sh:6 sets APP_COPY=/tmp/submission; :97-102 normally chooses /app/server.js and /app/app.db when /app is writable, while :104-111 always supplies HOME=$APP_COPY. Restart repeats this at :160-167. Therefore HOME need not be the running entry directory. test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template, so correct the task-specific note rather than changing shared harness policy. The raw launch-only fixture at row23-home-probe-v2/canonical_home_alternative/fixture-server.js:8-10 generates the unchanged public HTML beneath the promised HOME app directory but serves files relative to its actual entry directory. canonical_home_alternative/observed.json:12-22 records health 200 and workspace 404; home_matches_entry_control/observed.json:12-22 records both 200 with only HOME corrected in the isolated control (container.py:59-64). Artifact SHA256s verified against the current index: canonical observation af8b1eb73258f96ab07b892ff5071d26982a1f8973074b2ef77ed8f0d896a3aa; HOME control b8f08fb80f614b5fc71e68b56293b20b47da561db9487a5e73f5e44d3bf33407; fixture 5c766dcce64dd57073824c953d239c5902b5830095702c44085b7acbc3ba71b7; driver b616dd1cc0dd35060e2a46409b5ba6c52c9e850ef89ff4a1c789c82223db2ac7. The source-binding hashes match the current frozen test.sh, note, Dockerfile, server and public index. Other inspected repeated facts agree: /app/server.js, port 3000, /api/health, DB_PATH, /assets/seed_data.json, no accounts, Node/runtime package versions, five-second source-run budget, claude-code + z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, scoring shares 0.6/0.2/0.2 with functional floor 0.05, APP_RESTART_HELPER and single restart_app use. task.toml quotes no criterion count. Re-derived counts are 1 Render, 1 Constraints, 74 Functional, 6 Polish, 6 Visual; Functional's quoted 23 protocols equals its 23 headings and six-phase plan. No fixed calendar clock or fixed dated seed figures are required. Weak-app check: the raw all-503 fixture is admitted by launch liveness, but the actual Render/Constraints contracts require successful authored execution and a shared write/read, so that admission is not evidence of a passing grade. No provider/full configured judge run, Oracle score or portal pass is inferred from these source comparisons or launch-only observations.
counterexample: A conforming implementation can generate its public entry HTML beneath process.env.HOME, relying on integration.md:7's statement that HOME is the running app directory, and then serve relative to __dirname. The supplied isolated alternative preserves the golden HTML and otherwise golden server but receives /api/health 200 and / 404 under the actual launcher; changing only the control's HOME to the entry directory restores / 200. Thus the written runtime fact can cause a false failure for an otherwise valid implementation. Conversely, a dead all-503 app can satisfy launcher reachability but cannot satisfy the written browser gates; no false full pass is claimed.
suggested_fix: Revise integration.md:7 to state that HOME is a writable submission-copy directory which can differ from the running entry directory, and retain the existing instruction to resolve app files from their actual location; preserve the canonical launcher.
